statusDetail: Coverage-complete agentic audit across homepage, section, article, search, and failure-state archetypes.

page.notes: German public news site. A custom consent/subscription wall appears before content. Coverage excludes checkout, authenticated account management, ePaper, games, weather, and third-party product storefronts because they are separate/secondary products.

paths.description: Homepage and first-visit consent state; represents editorial landing and global chrome.
Politics listing; represents section/index templates and long card feeds.
News article; represents the primary reading journey and article metadata.
Search results for Ukraine; represents the primary form and results flow.
Synthetic missing URL; represents HTTP failure and recovery state.

findings.summary: No user-preference theming
findings.evidence: Dark and reduced-motion probes show a fixed light surface and an animation remains under reduce.
findings.suggestedFix: Add color-scheme/light-dark theming and disable non-essential motion in prefers-reduced-motion.

findings.summary: Abrupt multi-page navigation
findings.evidence: No view-transition rules are present on a link-heavy MPA.
findings.suggestedFix: Progressively add @view-transition { navigation: auto } with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: Long pages provide little position-aware guidance
findings.evidence: The CSS probe found no scroll-state/progress treatment on pages up to 27,772 px high.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a lightweight reading/progress cue or responsive scrolled header where it improves orientation.

findings.summary: Consent/subscription wall obscures all content
findings.evidence: First-load screenshots across all templates show the wall occupying the viewport before content.
findings.suggestedFix: Make the consent choice non-obscuring where legally possible and offer clear, equally accessible choices; keep content-first access.

findings.summary: Consent controls use custom div semantics
findings.evidence: Shadow DOM inspection identifies div-based pseudo-buttons inside a custom dialog implementation.
findings.suggestedFix: Use native dialog/button semantics, focus management, Escape behavior, and an accessible name.

findings.summary: Advertising and third-party chrome dominate the load
findings.evidence: 26 ad-like surfaces and 59 third-party requests compete with editorial content.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer below-fold ad/recommendation surfaces and reserve editorial space first.

findings.summary: No component container queries
findings.evidence: CSS probe finds no @container rules across reusable cards.
findings.suggestedFix: Adopt container queries for cards reused in main, rail, and narrow placements with viewport fallbacks.

findings.summary: Many interactive targets are undersized
findings.evidence: 140/296 visible targets are under 44 px in one dimension.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase hit areas to at least 44x44 CSS px without forcing visual bulk; retain visible focus.

findings.summary: First-time reading and search are blocked
findings.evidence: The consent wall intercepts each primary path before content is usable.
findings.suggestedFix: Allow the primary content journey to proceed with a clear privacy choice and no dead-end wall.

findings.summary: Mobile LCP is outside the good range
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 3.94 s.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the LCP image/content, reduce consent/render-blocking dependency delay, and validate LCP <=2.5 s.

findings.summary: Search and section layouts shift materially
findings.evidence: Observed CLS is 0.2455 on search and 0.1283 on section.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve ad/image/widget space with explicit dimensions/aspect-ratio and stabilize fonts.

findings.summary: Heavy render path and resource delivery
findings.evidence: 90 requests transfer 3.99 MB; render-blocking opportunity is about 1.01 s.
findings.suggestedFix: Inline/minimize critical CSS, defer noncritical styles/scripts/media, and set intentional preload/fetch priority.

findings.summary: Unused and legacy code ships on initial load
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 132 KiB unused JS, 29 KiB unused CSS, and 8 KiB legacy JS.
findings.suggestedFix: Code-split by feature/consent state and remove legacy/duplicate payloads.

findings.summary: Numerous links have no accessible name
findings.evidence: Lighthouse fails link-name; 83-89 unnamed links occur on core templates.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every linked card/icon a discernible accessible name and remove empty duplicate anchors.

findings.summary: Text contrast failures
findings.evidence: Lighthouse fails the WCAG color-contrast audit.
findings.suggestedFix: Update affected color tokens to meet WCAG AA in normal and interaction states.

findings.summary: Heading hierarchy skips levels
findings.evidence: The politics section jumps from H1 to H3 and includes empty H3 elements; Lighthouse fails heading-order.
findings.suggestedFix: Use semantic H2 section headings, H3 descendants, and remove empty headings.

findings.summary: Console errors occur on load
findings.evidence: Lighthouse fails errors-in-console.
findings.suggestedFix: Resolve the recorded exceptions/network console errors and add production error monitoring.

findings.summary: Images lack dimensions and are oversized
findings.evidence: 14/17 homepage images lack dimensions and seven are oversized.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit width/height or aspect-ratio and responsive modern sources sized for each slot.

findings.summary: Article schema is generic
findings.evidence: The article JSON-LD is WebPage rather than NewsArticle despite article-specific content.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish accurate NewsArticle JSON-LD with headline, image, dates, author, publisher, and canonical URL.

findings.summary: Security headers and cookie protections are missing
findings.evidence: No CSP/HSTS/nosniff/frame/referrer/permissions policies; five cookies lack Secure.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a measured CSP, HSTS, nosniff, frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, and secure cookie flags.

findings.summary: Large third-party footprint before consent
findings.evidence: 59 third-party requests transfer 3.41 MB across 19 origins.
findings.suggestedFix: Gate nonessential vendors until consent, consolidate vendors, batch analytics, and minimize retained identifiers.

findings.summary: CSS relies entirely on physical directions
findings.evidence: Probe found zero logical declarations and 545 physical left/right declarations.
findings.suggestedFix: Use logical margin/padding/inset/size properties for new and touched layout code.

findings.summary: Consent and subscription choice is asymmetric
findings.evidence: ACCEPT ALL is dominant and no reject action is visible; subscription price is absent.
findings.suggestedFix: Present reject/manage choices with equivalent prominence and show subscription price/terms before commitment.

findings.summary: Background media and third parties consume most bytes
findings.evidence: Media transfers 2.73 MB and third parties 3.41 MB of a 3.99 MB initial load.
findings.suggestedFix: Do not start media until visible/user-requested; defer third parties and enforce per-template byte budgets.

findings.summary: Many crawlable links lack descriptive text
findings.evidence: Representative pages contain 75-89 empty/unnamed anchors and Lighthouse fails link-name.
findings.suggestedFix: Consolidate linked cards into one descriptive anchor and add accessible names to icon-only links.
